question: The reply of 22 September 2025 on the Commission’s financing of independent Belarusian media and journalists indicated that DT Global Europe was selected by the Commission to be a beneficiary under the dedicated EU4 Independent Media programme (EU4IM) for Belarusian independent media and journalists, which ran from 3 January 2022 to 2 May 2025. Meanwhile, in response to enquiries, DT Global has replied that the Commission should provide the materials and information requested. In light of the above: 1.
Does the Commission intend to make the contract concluded between the Commission and DT Global Europe concerning the EU4IM project (ENI/2021/423-349) public, along with any annexes and attachments?
Does the Commission intend to make the final report on the implementation of the EU4IM project (substantive and financial) submitted by the contractor public, along with any accompanying documents?
Which criteria were given the most weight in selecting DT Global Idev Europe SL as a beneficiary of the EU4IM programme?
answer: EN on behalf of the European Commission (28.1.2026) The Commission does not intend to publish the contract concluded with DT Global Europe, its annexes and attachments, nor the final report, as these documents contain personal data and commercially sensitive information which are protected from public disclosure.

The award of the contract followed an evaluation based on the most economically advantageous tender, applying the best price-quality ratio. The assessment of technical quality focused on the proposed organisation and methodology, as well as the profiles of the key experts, in line with the applicable rules for the selected procedure1.
The Commission shares key information, such as award data, through its Financial Transparency System2.
